scope: Scoped portability refactor for installing and running aSTT-comp from different checkout locations on Windows and macOS.
implemented: Touched backend and scripts use packages.common.runtime_paths helpers for runtime locations.
Unix web wrappers delegate to scripts/webctl.py instead of killing arbitrary port listeners.
Library audio-folder placeholder no longer contains a machine-specific local path.

risks: Large pre-existing dirty worktree increases integration risk.
Default pytest temp root had ACL problems on this machine.
macOS portability still needs real validation of toolchain and executable bits.
Generated documentation and historical logs may intentionally contain absolute historical paths.
Model installation is the largest cross-machine risk.
recommendations: Add Windows and macOS CI smoke jobs.
Use ASTT_RUNTIME_ROOT for portable installs and tests.
Run full pytest on Windows with an explicit clean --basetemp.
Defer broad component decomposition until portability base is stable.
